d: The US Department of War’s Defense Intelligence Agency has published a report detailing space-based threats from China, Russia, Iran and North Korea, including a satellite image of a secretive Chinese space plane believed to be Shenlong. Firstpost examines China’s space programme and how its aircraft compares with the US Space Force’s X-37B. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump says he is willing to work with Democrats if Republicans lose the upcoming midterm elections, while threatening to use his veto power to push negotiations.
